# Native palette reference fixture

SHA-256: `f8cbfb955ab3ef4474012dbb7103a7b8c5260c9c6ccde96aea6952a4980124dc`,
19,238 bytes, LF. Obtained read-only via GitHub contents API (decoded base64).

`herdr-0.1.17.d.ts` and `herdr-0.1.18.d.ts` are the corresponding pinned public

Upstream project attribution/license remains in the repository's retained third-party notices.
